notes:
Summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS evaluating Redwood as primary inference provider. Initial appetite for Hosted API to validate fidelity and infra integration; if POC meets latency and unit-cost thresholds they want Dedicated for predictable throughput and data isolation.

POC scope: two-week run using hosted_api with traffic routing to a 13B open model for embeddings and a 7B chat model for in-app summarization. Test vectors: support transcripts, product docs + 20k QPS token-limited runs. Primary eval metrics: p95 latency, tokens/sec cost, and embedding recall for search.

Cost-optimization workshop goals (Mar18):
- Walkthrough batching strategies: request-level batching vs continuous batching; expected latency impact and throughput gains.
- KV/prefix caching review: cache hit-rate targets (aim 30-45% for support flows) and eviction policy suggestions.
- Quantization profiles: test int8 vs int4 on specific 7B/13B variants; tradeoffs on quality vs unit cost.
- Unit economics modeling: build tokens-per-session, avg tokens/respond, hit-rate sensitivity; show Dedicated committed vs hosted on-demand break-even for their projected volume.

Key quotes/asks: "We need to know whether switching to Dedicated will cut our per-message cost by at least 40% while keeping p95 <200ms" — Head of Product.

Security notes: Require SSO/SAML + KMS integration; retention controls for support transcripts (90 days default, longer for enterprise customers). Data residency request for EU customers only. Procurement wants 2 vendor references and a SOC2 addendum.

Logistics: sent pricing deck and security FAQ (drive links). POC kickoff scheduled Mar 12; workshop Mar 18. Next deliverable: Dedicated sizing + committed pricing proposal by Apr 30.
account_summary: Technical-first product org. High volume of short-chat interactions in-app, medium sensitivity data. Cost-sensitive but quality-conscious. Likely to convert if POC shows 30-50% unit-cost savings with preserved quality and integration path for VPC/KMS.
